text:
Maya: Heads-up — kicking off Opal onboarding. Quick sync to map stakeholders + success criteria. 10 min? @Leo @Jordan @Priya
Leo: Available now for a quick one. Who from Opal will attend?
Maya: Opal side: Claire (PM), Ahmed (infra lead), Rina (security). Claire prefers mornings. They want staging by 4/3, beta by 4/17.
Priya: Got it. I'll own enablement docs + runbook. Can we confirm SSO + KMS decisions? @Jordan do we need anything from runtime team?
Jordan: Runtime: need model size, avg seq length, qps estimate. Ask Opal for peak from 9am-5pm. If >200 qps we'll recommend Dedicated.
Maya: Success criteria proposal: 1) Staging end-to-end inference w/ sample traffic 2) <=150ms p95 cold start for <8k context 3) Docs & training for 3 engineers 4) Security review sign-off
Leo: :thumbsup: Can we add "observability dashboard set up" as deliverable?
Priya: Yes. Also plan a 1-hr enablement session + 30-min followup 2 weeks later. I can draft slides.
Maya: Timeline draft:
```
Week 1: infra + creds, SSO test
Week 2: staging deploy + smoke tests
Week 3: load test + runbook
Week 4: go/no-go + training
```
Jordan: Risk: SSO may add 5 business days if Okta cert exchange delayed. Mitigation: temporary API key for testing.
Leo: Renewal risk note: Opal is tied to a concurrent-contract with another vendor in month 3; need to surface ROI metrics by week 6.
Maya: Action items:
- Maya: schedule weekly 30m standups (Wednesdays)
- Priya: enablement deck by 3/29
- Jordan: perf baseline by 3/31
- Leo: commercial kickoff + ROI template
- Claire (Opal): provide model artifacts + expected qps
I'll ping Claire for times. Any objections?
Priya: :eyes: fine.
Jordan: No objections.
Leo: All good. I'll loop in Finance for ROI template.
OnboardBot: Reminder: <#cs-repo> onboarding checklist created: https://redwood.internal/cs/opal-onboard (assigned to Maya)
Maya: Thanks — I'll invite Opal to the first standup. I'll post a brief summary after the call.
